originality.rationale: The all-positive-parameter five-run interval classification, exact output count, and sharp unrestricted five-run maximum are not consequences stated or implied in the checked primary texts or closest published records. Generic RLE and output-sensitive enumeration algorithms solve individual instances but neither provide a symbolic extremum nor the asymmetric residue-one phenomenon. The symmetric five-run subfamily is strictly narrower and has a smaller maximum at lengths congruent to one modulo three. Priority against unindexed equivalent formulas remains uncertain.
